step1_analysis.description: A high-frequency Colpitts oscillator used as a test structure to monitor the maximum oscillation frequency (fmax) of transistors by measuring the minimum bias current required for oscillation.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L * (C1*C2)/(C1+C2))). With L=1nH, C1=C2=5pF, f = 3.18 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the LC tank components.

output_voltage_pp.description: Peak-to-peak voltage amplitude at the output node N1

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage swing is limited by the supply (1.8V) and transistor saturation. Expected to swing between ~0.2V and ~1.6V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large signal oscillation in voltage-limited regime.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly set by the ideal bias current source and supply voltage.

min_bias_current.description: Minimum bias current (I_osc) required to sustain oscillation

sky130_expected.calculation: gm >= 1/Rp. Rp = 1kOhm. gm >= 1mS. gm = sqrt(2*mu*Cox*(W/L)*Id). Id >= (1mS)^2 / (2 * 270uA/V^2 * 133) = 14uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Theoretical minimum current to overcome tank losses (R=1k).

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, peak-to-peak voltage, and power consumption of the Colpitts oscillator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Colpitts Oscillator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=20 L_xm1=0.15
.param C1_val=5p C2_val=5p L_val=1n R_val=1k I_bias=5m

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

I1 VDD N1 {I_bias}
C1 N1 0 {C1_val}
C2 N0 0 {C2_val}
XM1 N1 N0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_xm1} L={L_xm1}
R N1 0 {R_val}
L N0 N1 {L_val}

.ic v(N1)=1.8 v(N0)=0

.control
  tran 10p 20n uic
  
  meas tran v_max max v(N1) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran v_min min v(N1) from=10n to=20n
  let v_pp = v_max - v_min
  print v_pp
  
  meas tran t_period trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=20 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=21
  let f_osc = 1 / t_period
  print f_osc
  
  meas tran I_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
  let P_dc = -I_vdd * 1.8
  print P_dc
  
  quit
.endc
.end
